company.description: The company name as given in the input.

studio_archetype.description: One short phrase: founder-led boutique, DP-led, agency, huge production company, or unknown.

operating_model.description: ONE short structural fact not already implied by studio_archetype - e.g. "Owner-operated", "In-house production and post", "Two-person crew". Do not restate studio_archetype here. UNKNOWN if nothing distinct is supported.

studio_personality.description: 1-3 tags from the closed vocabulary describing how you'd work with them day to day. Empty array if none fit.

creative_dna.description: 1-3 tags from the closed vocabulary answering: what kind of creative work excites them? A genuine creative specialty, not a restatement of what their clients happen to sell. Empty array if none fit.

visual_dna.description: 1-3 tags from the closed vocabulary describing the actual look - the vocabulary a colorist would use to start a grade. Empty array if none fit.

decision_maker.description: Name and/or title only, short. e.g. "Founder (Mara)". UNKNOWN if unsupported.

buyer_personality.description: 1-3 tags from the closed vocabulary on how they evaluate and decide. Empty array if none fit.

human_angle.description: Exactly ONE concrete, specific human observation, a few words. Never a generic compliment. UNKNOWN if unsupported.

colorkaar_angle.description: A short punchy phrase, roughly 3-8 words, on why Colorkaar specifically matters here. Not a sentence that explains itself with an em-dash. Not an email.

conversation_starter.description: A specific topic to open with, a few words, not a compliment.

avoid.description: Short tags (1-3 words each) for topics/tones that would misread the room. e.g. ["Pricing", "Awards", "Volume framing"]. Not sentences. Free text - situational, not a closed vocabulary.

why_this_lead.description: 3-5 short bullets synthesizing the case for outreach - the gut-check a producer reads before deciding whether to write at all. Can reuse tags from other fields plus specific facts. e.g. ["Founder-led", "Image-first", "No internal grading", "Relationship-driven"].

outreach_priority.description: Your proposed priority tier. Recomputed deterministically downstream from studio_archetype and confidence - reason honestly.

confidence.description: High: multiple facts stated directly. Medium: some facts stated, real inference required. Low: mostly inferred, thin evidence.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences on why you chose the human angle and Colorkaar angle, and why this confidence level. Debug only, dropped before export.
